event.title: Manchester City Found Guilty of Financial Rule Breaches by Premier League
event.canonical_title: Manchester City Found Guilty of Financial Rule Breaches by Premier League
event.summary: Manchester City has been found guilty of nearly all of the 115 charges related to breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, which span from the 2009-10 to 2022-23 seasons. The club reportedly plans to appeal the decision.

timeline.title: Manchester City Found Guilty of Financial Rule Breaches by Premier League
timeline.summary: Manchester City has been found guilty of all charges related to breaches of Premier League financial rules from the 2009-10 to 2017-18 seasons, as confirmed by the league. The club expressed disappointment and surprise at the verdict and announced plans to appeal the decision.
key_facts: Manchester City guilty of all charges
Club plans to appeal the decision
